content_of_post_to_comment: Not to be “old man yells at cloud” , but I find myself having to buy a new toaster for the first time in over a decade and half of them are IOT smart toasters with an app. Like I said, I'm not luddite, but at the same time I'm 100% confident we don't need a smart toaster as a society. The toaster was invented in like 1929 and the only significant improvement on the design was the bagel function. It's good. Leave it be.
